description: National Aquaculture Development Authority of Sri Lanka - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. Ord.  No. 1736/21 of 13.12.2011 substituting items in schedule A of the National Acquaculture Development Authority Act
reasoning: This gazette content consists of regulations made by the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development under the National Aquaculture Development Authority of Sri Lanka Act. It contains amendments to fee structures and regulatory requirements for aquaculture operations, which falls under the category of legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation.
